title: Artifact Package for 'Architecture Search in Self-Modifying Systems: The Scale-Decay Regularity of General Selection and Randomized Controlled Audit Discipline'
description: Auditable artifact package for the manuscript 'Architecture Search in Self-Modifying Systems: The Scale-Decay Regularity of General Selection and Randomized Controlled Audit Discipline'. Contents: (1) a skill-graph / neuroevolution platform with the Experiment G five-condition batch, the preregistered scale-scan protocol v2 plus its post-hoc seed expansion, and the three-factor scan, all with per-seed and per-generation event logs; (2) two audit-trail variants retained on purpose - a cross-scale RNG-drift defect version caught by an internal hard self-check, and a fast-resume contamination control; (3) a GEP six-stage self-modification LLM pipeline: pilot batch, formalized validation run (G0 probes plus the S1-S4 pipeline checks), and state snapshots; (4) the preregistered three-arm verdict batch run on two base-model tiers (qwen3-instruct-30b and qwen3-14b) together with its post-hoc grammar-constrained extension batches TJ_B1b and TJ_B1C - covering per-event logs, verdict JSONs that each record the SHA256 of the frozen criteria file governing them, and the three independently frozen criteria files themselves. Every quantitative claim in the manuscript is cross-checkable against a named file in this package; MANIFEST.sha256 lists the SHA256 of every released file. All local experiments reproduce on a single RTX 3080 Laptop GPU; the two LLM tiers ran through a local llama-server inference chain.
notes: Code is released under MIT; data and logs under CC-BY-4.0. MANIFEST.sha256 lists the SHA256 of every released file and excludes only tool-state directories (.mimosa/) and bytecode caches (__pycache__/).
